Offline voice dependencies

whisper.cpp v1.7.6, commit a8d002cfd879315632a579e73f0148d06959de36
https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp
Copyright (c) 2023-2024 The ggml authors
The fetched source's LICENSE covers whisper.cpp and its bundled ggml code;
redistribute it alongside this notice with the voice-enabled build.

OpenAI Whisper tiny.en model, converted to ggml by ggerganov/whisper.cpp:
https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-tiny.en.bin
SHA256 921e4cf8686fdd993dcd081a5da5b6c365bfde1162e72b08d75ac75289920b1f
Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI
https://github.com/openai/whisper

Build variants: voice-portable is the baseline CPU flavor. voice-avx2 requires
AVX2, FMA, F16C and BMI2 from process start; it is not a portable fallback build.
voice-off has no recognizer backend. The flavor is included in the EXE build label.
